senses.gloss:
r. 4th cl. (सृज्यते) r. 6th cl. (सृजति)
1 To leave, to quit.
2 To be left or abandoned.
2 To create, to make.
With उत् or वि prefixed,
To abandon, to quit, to reject.
With सम्,
To unite, to be in alliance or contact with.

m. (सृक् or सृग् सृट् or सृड्)
A creator.
E.
सृज् to create, aff. क्विप्.

m. (-रः)
Natron, alkali.
E.
see सर्ज्जिकाक्षार.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Being made or created.
E.
